howto.name: Upload a MOV file
howto.text: Drop a .mov file from QuickTime, an iPhone or a camera.

howto.name: PrivaTools remuxes via FFmpeg
howto.text: Streams are moved into Matroska, which holds multiple audio and subtitle tracks comfortably.

howto.name: Convert and download
howto.text: Click Convert. Matroska holds multiple audio and subtitle tracks comfortably, which makes it a better archive container than MOV.

faq.a: MKV is a flexible archival container that can hold multiple audio and subtitle tracks. If the MOV's codecs are MKV-compatible, the conversion remuxes losslessly.
When remuxing (same codecs), yes — no quality change, just a different container. Incompatible codecs are re-encoded.
No — temporary input/output, removed after the response.
